content:
Apple TV has long been hailed as the "new HBO" because of its quality-over-quantity approach. But in recent months, the streaming platform has launched so many shows I want to watch that I simply can't keep up.

Apple TV's quality and output are rising in tandem — the streaming platform has reached a new level

I've subscribed to Apple TV since it launched in 2019, and the platform typically only has one or two shows at a time that I want to watch.

This model resembles HBO, which has always built its brand on producing fewer but higher-quality shows, distinguishing itself from its competitors.

However, over the past few years, Apple's production volume has gradually increased, and at the same time, their hit rate also seems to have improved.

The result is: Apple now has so many great shows that I simply can't watch them all — I'm completely swamped.

Here are the Apple TV shows currently airing new episodes each week:

  • 《足球女將》（Ted Lasso）, one of my all-time favourite shows
  • 《慢馬》（Slow Horses）, another one of Apple's greatest shows ever
  • 《黑暗物質》（Dark Matter）, a sci-fi series I loved in its first season but haven't yet started watching season two
  • 《兄弟》（Brothers）, a new half-hour comedy starring Matthew McConaughey and Woody Harrelson that looks quite fun
  • 《Last Seen》, a new thriller I've heard great things about but haven't watched yet
  • Then there's《Women in Blue》and《Knife Edge》— these two I might watch during the off-season, but for now they're only secondary priorities

I'm really looking forward to starting《黑暗物質》, because its first season already made it my favourite sci-fi show after《人生切割術》（Severance）and《Pluribus》. But I just haven't found the time to begin season two. Half-hour comedies are always my go-to stress reliever, so《兄弟》has already made it onto my watchlist.

I enjoy crime thrillers and shows involving family, so《Last Seen》looks right up my alley — yet despite Stephen King's praise, I still haven't started it.

And the above is only the shows currently airing.

I still haven't finished catching up on《Silo》（Silo）season three, and although《Sugar》season two has good reviews and I liked the show myself, I haven't even started it. If I ignore shows on other platforms, there's genuinely an endless queue of things to watch on Apple, but shows on other platforms keep me just as busy.

October is approaching, and Apple will launch seven new series and films in a single month — the most I can recall in any one month.

Ultimately, I'm genuinely happy for Apple TV's strong performance. Their win over HBO at this year's Emmys was well deserved.

What are your thoughts on Apple TV's recent and currently airing shows? Feel free to share in the comments section.

Apple TV's monthly subscription is US$14.99, with discount bundles available through Apple One.
